choice_policy: One role per complete episode. Evidence explicitly covers both settings; input generation is independent of the hidden setting.
lesson_policy: 3 labeled demonstrations followed by 4 distinct queries. Every input contains a pair plus preserved lone 3 and lone 2 witnesses. Each query is checked against the alternate parameter and global-replacement rival using demonstrations only.
limitations: Evidence covers two episodes and two declared rival families. It does not prove uniqueness against every imaginable rule or authorize shared runtime/catalog integration.

meaning.green3: paired green 3 survives as cyan 8; paired red 2 is erased to 0
meaning.red2: paired red 2 survives as cyan 8; paired green 3 is erased to 0

scope: proposed task-local prototype; not a canonical rule change, shared production API, approval, or training admission
